japanese_evidence_rule: strong_kana = (high_conf_kana_count>=4 AND distinct_regions_with_kana>=2) OR (high_conf_kana_count>=6); unchanged from OCR-v1/v2
korean_evidence_rule: strong_hangul = ko_distinct_high_conf_hangul_regions>=2 AND ko_max_hangul_run_length>=2 (conf>=0.5 per region, contiguous Hangul run length within a single recognized-text string); NEW in v3, replaces the saturated korean_hangul_count>=2 raw-count guard
conflict_precedence: strong_kana AND strong_hangul -> UNVERIFIED (conflict); strong_kana AND NOT strong_hangul -> JAPANESE_MISMATCH; strong_hangul AND NOT strong_kana -> NOT_JAPANESE_EVIDENCE; neither -> latin-dominant NOT_JAPANESE_EVIDENCE check, else UNVERIFIED
